1981-2403-2415-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2403-2415-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

147-3085-5256.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3085-5256.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2493-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2493-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
2493-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Archaeomancer and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

967-3809-3899-5184-7087.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2018-4247--73.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
2018-4247--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

1765-3899-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1765-3899-5972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

240-3899-5470-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature that enters with at least five +1/+1 counters

1494-2382-4153--186.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a creature with haste that enters with at least five +1/+1 counters on it and creating a delayed triggered ability.
At the beginning of your end step, the delayed triggered ability from Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the creature token.
When the token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7934.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Federation Field Medic.
When Federation Field Medic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Federation Field Medic enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3499-3519-7908.easyPrerequisites: The Notary Hobbits' commander tax is 8 or less.
3499-3519-7908.description:
Cast The Notary Hobbits by paying {3}{G}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When The Notary Hobbits enters, it triggers, creating two nonlegendary token copies of it.
Activate The Notary Hobbits and the two Notary Hobbits tokens by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C} for each Halfling you control.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the nontoken Notary Hobbits, adding six {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return The Notary Hobbits from exile to the command zone.
Repeat.
3499-3519-7908.notes: It's possible to start with a higher commander tax, but you'll need to control more Halflings and/or have more mana to start.

2073-5686-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-5686-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3504-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3504-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3504-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6154.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6154.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1368-1849-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1849-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2366-4478-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4478-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2837-3490-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
2837-3490-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat.

3564-3967-4275-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
3564-3967-4275-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3564-3967-4275-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

625-1978-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
625-1978-5704.description:
Cause Leafkin Avenger to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2034-4094-5220-5477-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4094-5220-5477-6961.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

654-907-5449-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
654-907-5449-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

225-280-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-280-5451-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2558-6351-6798--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-6351-6798--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2438-4063-6625.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2060-4029-4893-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-4029-4893-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1170-1645-4826-5921-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

573-1479-4677.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-4677.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Zendikar's Roil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

requires.n: Creature with Mana Cost Equal to {0}

2232-3197-5684--1.notablePrerequisites: Herd Baloth has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2232-3197-5684--1.description:
Cast the creature by paying {0}.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, and Cloudstone Curio triggers if the creature was not an artifact.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, if applicable, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Shaile, Dean of Radiance // Embrose, Dean of Shadow

2060-4222-5622.notablePrerequisites: Shaile does not have summoning sickness.
2060-4222-5622.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}.
Activate Shaile by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and any other creature that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Shaile.
Repeat from step 2.

3518-4393-4812-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Dance of Many from your graveyard by paying {U}{U}.
When Dance of Many enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Muldrotha.
Put the nontoken Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Animate Dead from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the token Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Muldrotha token dies, Dance of Many's third ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dance of Many.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast any other permanent cards in your graveyard that are not solely enchantments and/or artifacts.

1350-2104-4423.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Temporal Manipulation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

1353-3323-4020-4772.notablePrerequisites: Tevesh Szat and Sidar Kondo of Jamuraa are your commanders.
1353-3323-4020-4772.description:
Cast Tevesh Szat by paying {4}{B}, plus commander tax (if applicable).
Tevesh Szat enters the battlefield with eight loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Norn's Choirmaster triggers, proliferating, putting two loyalty counters on Tevesh Szat.
Activate Tevesh Szat's last loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, choosing to put it into the command zone.
Resolve the ability, putting Tevesh Szat and all other commanders from the command zone onto the battlefield and gaining control of all commanders.
Norn's Choirmaster triggers at least once, proliferating at least once; choose to put exactly two loyalty counters on Tevesh Szat.
Repeat from step 4.

126-2647-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
126-2647-3976.description:
Cast Warrior's Oath by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Warrior's Oath and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creature that has Warrior's Oath noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Warrior's Oath without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Obeka by tapping it, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Warrior's Oath trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

678-1872-3003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
678-1872-3003.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Composite Golem from your hand by paying at most {4}.
Repeat.
